about_the_game:
About

As Gizmo, your little robot friend, or robo-homie, you'll navigate through increasingly complex environments by writing Python code, transforming programming concepts into tangible puzzle solutions.

The game's 25-level Campaign introduces programming fundamentals through practical challenges. Starting with basic movement commands, you'll progress to advanced concepts like functions, arrays, and algorithmic thinking – all while incrementally solving puzzles that require both coding skill and planning.

Beyond the campaign, test your expertise in Puzzle Mode, where conventional rules are bent to create unique challenges, or dive into Endless Mode's procedurally generated mazes. Each run in Endless Mode becomes progressively more complex, offering infinite opportunities to refine your coding strategies, collect unique trinkets that augment Gizmo's capabilities, and rank on the leaderboards.

Key Features

  • Hands-on Python programming in a fully interactive environment

  • Resource management system with health and energy mechanics

  • Progressive learning curve from basic movements to complex algorithms

  • Varied hazards including timed traps, oil spills, and electric fences

  • Strategic elements with recharge stations and repair points

  • Procedurally generated endless mode for continued challenges

  • Syntax and function unlocks that gradually expand coding possibilities
